func TestSendCommand_CreatesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&inbox.Message{}, &csuite.Agent{})

	args := []string{
		"send",
		"--from", "kyle",
		"--to", "alex",
		"--subject", "Test",
		"--priority", "high",
		"--type", "request",
		"--body", "Hello",
	}

	err := run(args, db, &bytes.Buffer{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("run() failed: %v", err)
	}

	var msg inbox.Message
	err = db.Where("from = ? AND to = ?", "kyle", "alex").First(&msg).Error
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to find created message: %v", err)
	}

	if msg.Subject != "Test" {
		t.Errorf("expected subject 'Test', got '%s'", msg.Subject)
	}
	if msg.Priority != "high" {
		t.Errorf("expected priority 'high', got '%s'", msg.Priority)
	}
	if msg.Type != "request" {
		t.Errorf("expected type 'request', got '%s'", msg.Type)
	}
	if msg.Body != "Hello" {
		t.Errorf("expected body 'Hello', got '%s'", msg.Body)
	}
}

func TestSendCommand_MissingRequiredFlags(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&inbox.Message{}, &csuite.Agent{})

	// Missing --from
	args := []string{
		"send",
		"--to", "alex",
		"--subject", "Test",
	}

	err := run(args, db, &bytes.Buffer{})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected error due to missing --from flag, got nil")
	}

	expectedErr := "missing required flag: --from"
	if err.Error() != expectedErr {
		t.Errorf("expected error '%s', got '%s'", expectedErr, err.Error())
	}
}

func TestListCommand_ShowsUnreadMessages(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&inbox.Message{}, &csuite.Agent{})

	// Insert 2 messages for agent "mike"
	msg1 := inbox.Message{From: "alice", To: "mike", Subject: "Msg 1", Archived: false}
	msg2 := inbox.Message{From: "bob", To: "mike", Subject: "Msg 2", Archived: false}
	msg3 := inbox.Message{From: "charlie", To: "mike", Subject: "Msg 3", Archived: true} // Archived
	msg4 := inbox.Message{From: "dave", To: "other", Subject: "Msg 4", Archived: false} // Different agent

	db.Create(&msg1)
	db.Create(&msg2)
	db.Create(&msg3)
	db.Create(&msg4)

	var stdout bytes.Buffer
	args := []string{"list", "--agent", "mike"}

	err := run(args, db, &stdout)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("run() failed: %v", err)
	}

	output := stdout.String()
	if !strings.Contains(output, "Msg 1") {
		t.Errorf("expected output to contain 'Msg 1', got: %s", output)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(output, "Msg 2") {
		t.Errorf("expected output to contain 'Msg 2', got: %s", output)
	}
	if strings.Contains(output, "Msg 3") {
		t.Errorf("expected output NOT to contain archived 'Msg 3', got: %s", output)
	}
	if strings.Contains(output, "Msg 4") {
		t.Errorf("expected output NOT to contain 'Msg 4' (different agent), got: %s", output)
	}

	// Verify count
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(output), "\n")
	count := 0
	for _, line := range lines {
		if line != "" {
			count++
		}
	}
	if count != 2 {
		t.Errorf("expected 2 messages, found %d", count)
	}
}

func TestArchiveCommand_ArchivesMessage(t *testing.T) {
	db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()
	db.AutoMigrate(&inbox.Message{}, &csuite.Agent{})

	msg := inbox.Message{From: "alice", To: "bob", Subject: "Archive Me", Archived: false}
	db.Create(&msg)

	args := []string{"archive", "--id", msg.ID.String()}
	err := run(args, db, &bytes.Buffer{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("run() failed: %v", err)
	}

	var updatedMsg inbox.Message
	db.First(&updatedMsg, msg.ID)
	if !updatedMsg.Archived {
		t.Error("expected message to be archived, but it is not")
	}
}
